Container.Name: flowchat
Container.Overview: Personal cross-device chat and file drop. Sign in from any browser to read, write and share files between your devices.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password you sign in with. It also encrypts all stored data, so use a long one and keep a copy: without it the data cannot be read.

Config.Name: Old password
Config.Description: Only when changing the password: enter the previous one here, start once, then clear this field. The stored data is moved to the new password.

Config.Name: Legacy encryption key
Config.Description: Only if you used ENCRYPTION_KEY with an older version: keep it for one start, then clear it. Data is now encrypted with the password.

Config.Name: Authenticator secret
Config.Description: Recommended. Base32 secret for an authenticator app; sign-in then also asks for a 6-digit code. See the README for how to create one.

Config.Name: Require HTTPS
Config.Description: Set to 1 when the app runs behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. Plain HTTP requests are then refused.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses the app answers on, e.g. flow.example.com. Empty allows any.

Config.Name: Auto-delete after (days)
Config.Description: Delete messages and files older than this many days. 0 keeps everything.

Config.Name: Outgoing webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Every new message is announced to this address (comma-separate several). Message text leaves the server, so only use services you trust.

Config.Name: Outgoing webhook secret
Config.Description: Optional. Signs outgoing webhooks (X-Flowchat-Signature header) so the receiver can check they are genuine.

Config.Name: Outgoing webhook includes text
Config.Description: Set to 0 to announce only that a message arrived, without its text or file name.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest file that can be uploaded

Config.Name: Session length (days)
Config.Description: How long a device stays signed in without being used

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 when behind a reverse proxy, so login throttling uses the real client address
